Our client, a dynamic Amazon FBA business with a global presence, is looking for a talented and experienced Supplier Sourcing & Procurement Specialist to join the vibrant team for a full time remote job. As a Supplier Sourcing & Procurement Specialist you will take ownership of all supplier-related communication.

This role involves identifying and establishing relationships with new production facilities and suppliers worldwide, obtaining competitive quotes, and negotiating contracts.

The specialist will work closely with the Product Engineer to filter products and ensure they meet quality control (QC) and lab testing requirements before moving forward with any new supplier. About the company: The company is specialised on developing and upscaling Amazon-based brands across the USA, Canada, Europe, and the UK.

With deep expertise in eCommerce and Amazon FBA, the company excels in buying, developing, and scaling brands to their fullest potential. The company navigates the complexities of international markets and high-performance marketing, ensuring seamless scalability and growth.

The company's portfolio includes several Amazon brands, primarily in the home and kitchen category, as well as some electronics. Its international team of 17 world-class talents manages all operations today.

Key Responsibilities: Research and identify new suppliers and production facilities globally, with a focus on China, India, Israel, Indonesia, Morocco, and other strategic regions. Communicate with existing and potential suppliers to negotiate pricing, MOQs, and lead times.

Request and analyze quotes, ensuring cost-effective solutions without compromising quality. Work closely with the Product Engineer to evaluate potential products and ensure compliance with QC standards and lab testing requirements before onboarding new suppliers.

Review and negotiate contracts to align with company standards and long-term supply needs. Maintain clear documentation of supplier agreements, pricing, and key terms. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure sourcing aligns with business objectives. Stay updated on industry trends, new materials, and production capabilities in different markets.

Requirements: Proven experience in supplier sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management. Experience working with Chinese factories is a must. Strong negotiation and communication skills. Ability to assess supplier reliability, pricing structures, and production capabilities. Experience in quality control and lab testing processes is a plus.

Experience in eCommerce, Amazon FBA, or consumer goods is a plus. Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills. Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and supplier management tools. Fluency in English is required; Mandarin or other relevant languages (e.g., Hindi, Arabic) is a plus.

What We Offer: A dynamic and supportive work environment with a team of dedicated professionals. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Competitive and timely salary. Full-time remote job (flexible hours). Originally posted on Himalayas

Our flagship product, the Splash Sprinkler Pad, became a popular and wet solution catering to diverse age groups. Motivated by our dedication to innovation, we have continued to evolve, expanding our product line to introduce more inventive and engaging water-based products for babies and kids.

Communication Skills: Able to communicate thoughts clearly in English written & spoken. Independent Work: The ability to work independently, make decisions with minimal supervision, and a strong sense of initiative are key attributes for this role. Proficient in data analysis and reporting.

Organized, sociable, goal-oriented Would be an added advantage Experience in creating SOPs Management Experience Experience in Vendor Management (Suppliers) Experience with SoStocked Our benefits Work for a Market-proven, fast-growing company. We are seeking an experienced Amazon Demand Planning & Inventory Manager to manage end-to-end Amazon demand planning and inventory optimization across multiple marketplaces including US, UK, and CA.

This role is responsible for building accurate forecasts, maintaining healthy inventory levels, and supporting Amazon operational planning across FBA and FBM channels.

The planner will collaborate closely with operations, warehousing, and planning teams to ensure consistent stock availability, optimize replenishment strategies, and support high-volume periods such as Prime Day and Q4.

Key focus areas include demand forecasting, replenishment planning, data analysis, Amazon inventory health management, and cross-functional collaboration to support inventory availability and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities
Demand Planning & Forecasting

Build and maintain monthly demand forecasts for Amazon marketplaces (US, UK, CA) at Style-Color level.
Manage a 9–12 month planning horizon with weekly and monthly forecasting outputs.
Utilize historical sales data, lead times, and master data inputs to drive forecasting accuracy.
Apply forecasting models (seasonality, regression, exponential smoothing) and AI tools to predict demand.

Amazon Operations & Inventory Management

Manage replenishment planning, inbound shipments, and storage optimization for FBA and FBM.
Partner with Amazon Operations to resolve shortages, chargebacks, and inventory discrepancies.
Support FBA vs. FBM fulfillment strategy during peak events such as Prime Day and Q4.
Coordinate kitting requirements and collaborate with Operations and 3PL partners for timely inbound execution.

Data Management & Analysis

Analyze sales and inventory data across Amazon Seller Central, NetSuite, and Looker.
Apply data transformations to ensure accuracy and resolve data quality issues.
Collaborate with data teams to validate inputs and maintain reliable inventory tracking.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with planning, warehousing, product, and sales teams to ensure inventory availability.
Provide Amazon planning insights and maintain clear reporting on priorities and workload.

7+ years of experience in Amazon demand planning and FBA inventory management
Strong proficiency in Excel and Amazon Seller Central (FBA, FBM, Direct Import)
Experience with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred) and inventory management tools
Proven experience in forecasting, demand planning, and data-driven decision making
Strong understanding of Amazon inventory health metrics, FBA logistics, and storage optimization
Experience managing Amazon replenishment, inbound shipments, and 3PL coordination
Expertise in forecasting methodologies (seasonality, regression, exponential smoothing)
Experience managing 9–12 month demand planning horizons
Experience in multi-channel DTC + Amazon environments, preferably in apparel or consumer goods
Familiarity with data tools such as BigQuery, Looker, or similar analytics platforms
Experience managing inventory across multiple Amazon marketplaces (US, UK, CA)

Access to a $200K+ perk marketplace with discounts on 150+ global services.

**Scope**
This is an exciting opportunity for a Procurement Specialist (Indirects) to join the Procurement Team at Sincereal Group during a period of significant transformation and growth.
Reporting to the Head of Procurement, you will take ownership of strategic sourcing and category management across key indirect spend categories for both the UK and French Sincereal sites. This is a fantastic opportunity to shape procurement strategy, streamline and enhance procurement processes, and deliver measurable value across the business.
Managing categories including logistics, engineering services, MRO, utilities, waste management, cleaning services, facilities management, and other factory-related contracts, you will be responsible for driving commercial value through effective sourcing, supplier management, and contract negotiation.
A key focus of the role will be developing and negotiating robust supplier framework agreements, ensuring contracts align with business objectives and deliver value throughout their lifecycle. You will also play an important role in strengthening procurement governance, ensuring all sourcing activities are compliant, auditable, and conducted in line with company policies.
Working closely with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Quality, and Site Leadership teams, you will lead sourcing projects from requirement definition through to implementation, while building strong stakeholder relationships and influencing decision-making across the business.
This role requires a commercially minded procurement professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and enjoys delivering results through collaboration and continuous improvement.
This position is based at the Bromborough UK site, with occasional travel to suppliers and the Itancourt, France site. Hybrid working flexibility is available.
**Role Purpose**
To deliver sustainable value through the development and execution of strategic sourcing and category management initiatives across indirect spend categories. The successful candidate will own the end-to-end procurement process, ensuring sourcing activities are compliant, commercially robust, and aligned to business objectives.

They will lead procurement projects from stakeholder requirement gathering and RFQ development through supplier negotiation, contracting, implementation, and supplier performance management.The role is responsible for establishing strong procurement governance, driving supplier accountability, and delivering measurable improvements in cost, service, quality, and risk management.

* Develop and execute category strategies across indirect spend categories including logistics, engineering services, MRO, utilities, waste management, cleaning services, and other factory-related contracts.
* Lead end-to-end sourcing activities including stakeholder engagement, market analysis, RFQ development, tender management, supplier evaluation, negotiation, contract award, and implementation.
* Prepare detailed RFQs that accurately capture stakeholder and business requirements and translate these into clear sourcing and evaluation criteria.
* Negotiate robust commercial agreements and supplier framework contracts that deliver value, mitigate risk, and support long-term business objectives.
* Manage supplier relationships and contract performance to ensure agreed service levels, performance targets, and value commitments are fully realised throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Identify and deliver cost reduction, cost avoidance, process improvement, and value creation opportunities across assigned categories.
* Establish and maintain strong procurement governance, ensuring sourcing activity is conducted in a compliant, transparent, and auditable manner.
* Work collaboratively with stakeholders across Operations, Engineering, Finance, Quality, Supply Chain, and Site Leadership to align procurement strategies with business priorities.
* Monitor supplier performance, contract compliance, market trends, risks, and opportunities, providing regular reporting and recommendations.
* Support procurement process improvement initiatives and contribute to the continued development of procurement capabilities across the business.
* Maintain accurate procurement and contract records within relevant business systems.
* Ensure all procurement activities comply with company policies, regulatory requirements, and internal audit standards.
**What will you make successful**
* Minimum 3 years' experience in procurement, with demonstrable experience in indirect procurement, category management, and strategic sourcing.
* Experience managing indirect spend categories within an FMCG, manufacturing, food production, or similar operational environment.
* Proven experience sourcing and managing categories such as logistics, engineering services, MRO, utilities, waste management, cleaning services, facilities management, or related indirect spend areas.
* Strong commercial acumen with proven success in contract negotiation and delivering measurable value from supplier relationships.
* Experience developing and negotiating supplier framework agreements and managing suppliers throughout the sourcing and contract lifecycle.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build credibility and challenge constructively at all levels of the organisation.
* Strong understanding of procurement governance, compliance, and audit requirements.
* Demonstrable experience leading competitive tender processes and developing detailed RFQs and supplier evaluation methodologies.
* Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities within a fast-paced and evolving environment.
* Comfortable working in a business undergoing transformation and able to navigate ambiguity with a pragmatic and solutions-focused approach.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Experience using ERP systems and procurement tools.
* CIPS qualified or working towards MCIPS is desirable, but not essential.
* Willingness to travel occasionally both domestically and internationally.
